It's ElevenLabs Partner Day, where we bring together our top partners to talk about how we win together. Hear from the leaders putting AI agents to work for their customers:
- Tim MacGregor , VP of AI and Data at TELUS Digital 
- James Young , Senior Managing Director at Slalom 
- Alvaro Chavez Campusano , Founder at Judini 
- Dorothy Copeland , Chief Partner Officer at NiCE 
- Brandon Webber , Managing Director at Accenture Song 
- Chloe Ho , GTM at Anthropic
